title: Business Development Associate
description:
About Weee!

Weee! is the largest and fastest-growing ethnic e-grocer in the United States, operating in one of the largest underserved categories in retail with affordable access to exciting ethnic food. By partnering with local suppliers, redesigning the value chain and leveraging social buying, Weee! is reshaping the grocery business entirely. You can read more about us on Business Insider, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Weee! is headquartered in Fremont, CA, and is currently available coast to coast with exceptional growth (5x YoY) across geographies, categories and ethnicities. We have raised $800M+ in funding to date from leading investors including Softbank Vision Funds, DST, Blackstone, Tiger Global, Lightspeed Ventures, Goodwater Capital, XVC and iFly. The opportunity now is to join a rocketship as we prepare for the next stage of growth, and an eventual public listing.

This role is onsite 5 days a week in Houston, TX

About the Role

As a Business Development Associate, you will be responsible for growing the regional sales and revenue of the local marketplace. In order to do so, you will be procuring famous/popular local restaurants, bakeries and other food providers, reaching out to potential partners, closing the deal and onboard them. You are starting at an exciting time while having the opportunity to build on the momentum and work with cross-functional teams and our global team.

Responsibilities

  • Research, establish relationships and engage with local restaurants and bakeries to enhance the local marketplace assortment.
  • Own and drive GMV growth in your region.
  • Identify business challenges, implement strategies to expand vendor partnerships, and grow revenue.
  • Continuously identify strategies to expand the vendor base and grow business revenue.
  • Collaborate with BD manager and vendors to develop effective promotions, and take initiatives on operational improvements. 
  • Guide vendors in ensuring product listing accuracy on Weee’s platform
  • Gather feedback from vendors and effectively communicate to the BD manager, technology, product, and customer service teams to improve the platform and address concerns.
  • Partner with the marketing team to create compelling promotional banners and content.
  • Partner with the local operations team to ensure smooth daily activities.

Qualifications

  • Customer focused with a sales driven mindset
  • Adapt to new situations quickly and think on your feet
  • Skilled at motivating potential partners to see the benefits Weee!’s local marketplace platform
  • Sales experience in a fast-paced or startup environment preferred
  • Bilingual proficiency in Chinese and English preferred, to effectively communicate with vendor communities.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health insurance package, including medical, dental, and vision.  PPO/HMO packages

  • Equity and Bonus 
  • Vacation, sick and holiday time off

description:

The opportunity now is to join a rocketship as we prepare for the next stage of growth, and an eventual public listing.

This role is onsite 5 days a week in Clifton, NJ

Facility Manager

About the role

As a Facility Manager, you are responsible for making sure systems of the built environment, or facility, work harmoniously. You make sure the places in which people work, play, learn and live are safe, comfortable, productive and sustainable. You will contribute to the organization’s bottom line through your responsibility for maintaining what are often an organization’s largest and most valuable assets, such as property, buildings, equipment and other environments that house personnel, productivity, inventory and other elements of operation.

Responsibilities:

Safety and compliance

  • Uphold OSHA, EPA and site safety standards and industry codes at both sites
  • Own fire and life safety: fire suppression, sprinkler and alarm testing
  • Share accountability for OSHA Process Safety Management (PSM) and EPA Risk Management Program (RMP) compliance for the Clifton ammonia system
  • Enforce lock-out/tag-out and safe work practices; act as a HazMat responder when needed
  • Own the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) binder at both sites

Maintenance and building systems

  • Build and run a preventative maintenance and life-cycle program for HVAC and other facility systems to cut unplanned downtime
  • Lead and document daily, weekly, monthly and annual inspections
  • Manage racking inspections and upkeep, plus trash and cardboard compactors
  • Advise on and track energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives

Powered industrial trucks (PIT)

  • Own PIT daily safety checks, preventative maintenance, and operator training and certification at both sites

Refrigeration co-management (Clifton)

  • Partner with the Chief Refrigeration Engineer on the ammonia freezer and glycol cooler systems, covering compliance, PM scheduling, budget and vendor coordination

Security and team leadership

  • Manage the security function and the facility/maintenance team at both sites, including staffing, training and performance
  • Train warehouse staff and supervisors on facility SOPs, PIT certification and emergency action procedures

Emergency response

  • Respond quickly to alarms, system failures, shutdowns and emergencies at either site, including off-hours
  • Maintain plans that reduce the impact of natural disasters and other disruptions

Vendors and budget

  • Procure bids, negotiate and review service contracts, and manage providers across both sites
  • Prepare and track facility budgets, expenses and maintenance costs; report regularly and drive cost-reduction initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Facilities Engineering or related qualification such as project management, business management or construction management, or a related field
  • 5+ years of work experience in a warehouse management role
  • Experience leading a security function and a facility/maintenance team
  • Working knowledge of OSHA safety, HazMat protocols and environmental compliance, including familiarity with OSHA PSM and EPA RMP for ammonia facilities
  • Experience running PIT programs: daily safety checks, preventative maintenance, and operator training and certification
  • Facility services experience across security, fire, janitorial and equipment maintenance
  • Strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills for general facility systems
  • Experience managing facility budgets, contracts and vendors across multiple sites
  • Ability to partner well with technical specialists on systems outside your direct scope
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, reporting and communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs, climb ladders and work in cold/freezer environments
  • Availability to respond to emergencies 24/7 when required

Nice to have

  • Working knowledge of ammonia refrigeration and/or glycol cooler systems
  • HazMat Responder certification
  • OSHA or Food Safety certification
  • Six Sigma (Green Belt) or project management certification

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health insurance package, including medical, dental, and vision.  PPO/HMO packages
  • 401k, 4% company match
  • Equity and Bonus 
  • Vacation, sick and holiday time off
  • Monthly mobile stipend
  • Monthly Weee! Points credits

This role is part-time position in Clifton, NJ;  Need someone to cover Thursday and Friday from 6pm to 6am. 

Refrigeration (Ammonia) System operators.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain the Ammonia refrigeration and other freon based cooling systems including, but not limited to operation, maintenance, and repairs.
  • Maintain and operate single, two stage, cascade ammonia systems and subsystems
  • Monitor and identify abnormal operating pressures, temperatures, and conditions within the refrigeration system, adjust, repairs and/or schedule service as required
  • Thoroughly understanding and able to handle refrigeration system components, including vacuum pumps, chillers, evaporators, condensers, compressors, controls, and valves etc.
  • Perform and delegate to daily, weekly, monthly, annually inspections, and preventative maintenance on the refrigeration equipment and other cooler machinery on and off-site as needed
  • Perform other maintenance duties such as plumbing, replacing valves, installing fixtures, detecting, and repairing leaks as needed
  • Handle hazardous materials as directed and follow guidance of OSHA and EPA
  • Monitor and record all system readings to document operation of the equipment and the system and provide reports and troubleshooting
  • Respond to emergency breakdowns of the refrigeration systems
  • Procure quotations and bids for the order of work scopes, repairs, parts, and construction projects as needed
  • Ensure continuous training and competency of refrigeration updates and standards
  • Train personnel for routine check and system following the SOP
  • Thoroughly understand and can act upon based on EAP and technical guidance during emergency and system malfunction situations
  • Handle unscheduled and emergency shut down of equipment
  • Ensure all refrigeration equipment is functioning in a safe and optimal manner
  • Ensures continuous operation of all the facility utility systems and supports preventative maintenance programs. 
  • Assists in the record-keeping and training requirements for all components of the Ammonia refrigeration system in compliance with State and federal guidelines. 
  • Must perform duties as assigned by the facility Manager. & Chief Engineer  

Qualifications

Must posses a Blue SealToxic To Operating license issued by the state of New Jersey 

  • 5+ of Ammonia and freon based refrigeration experience
  • 4+ years of active experience with cooling processes, ammonia refrigeration, and other freon based facilities within a produce and food processing and storage facility is a plus
  • Experience with screw and reciprocating compressors, recirculation pumps, HVAC units, air compressors, and associated control systems
  • Work experience in ammonia system pump-downs and repairs
  • Knowledge of chemical testing for cooling towers and ammonia system preferred
  • Strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills

title: Warehouse Supervisor I- Ambient/Cooler or Freezer
description:
About Weee!

Weee! is the largest and fastest-growing ethnic e-grocer in the United States, operating in one of the largest underserved categories in retail with affordable access to exciting ethnic food. By partnering with local suppliers, redesigning the value chain and leveraging social buying, Weee! is reshaping the grocery business entirely. You can read more about us on Business Insider, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Weee! is headquartered in Fremont, CA, and is currently available coast to coast with exceptional growth (5x YoY) across geographies, categories and ethnicities. We have raised $800M+ in funding to date from leading investors including Softbank Vision Funds, DST, Blackstone, Tiger Global, Lightspeed Ventures, Goodwater Capital, XVC and iFly. The opportunity now is to join a rocketship as we prepare for the next stage of growth, and an eventual public listing.

This role is onsite in Clifton, NJ and the shift starts at 3AM EST.

About the role

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing warehouse operations in Clifton, NJ. These operations include shipping, inventory, delivery. Your goal will be to increase operational efficiency and ensure a safe environment. 

Responsibilities

  • Maintain receiving, warehousing, and distribution operations by initiating, coordinating, and enforcing program, operational, and personnel policies and procedures
  • Evaluate performance metrics to ensure quality delivery and cost-efficient work-flow processes
  • Comply with federal, state, and local warehousing, material handling, and shipping requirements by understanding and studying existing and new legislation; enforcing adherence to requirements; advising management on needed actions
  • Safeguard warehouse operations and contents by establishing and monitoring security procedures and protocols
  • Control inventory levels by conducting physical counts; reconciling with data storage system
  • Maintains physical condition of warehouse by planning and implementing new design layouts; inspecting equipment; issuing work orders for repair and requisitions for replacement
  • Achieve financial objectives by preparing an annual budget; scheduling expenditures; analyzing variances; initiating corrective actions
  • Complete warehouse operational requirements by scheduling and assigning employees; following up on work results
  • Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed

Qualifications

  • 5 years of warehouse experience preferred
  • Food and Beverage Industry experience strongly preferred
  • Able to multitask and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent organizational skills are a must
  • Accuracy and attention to detail is a must
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health insurance package, including medical, dental, and vision.  PPO/HMO packages
  • 401k, 4% company match
  • Equity and Bonus 
  • Vacation, sick and holiday time off
  • Monthly mobile stipend
  • Monthly Weee! Points credits

Compensation Range

  • The US base salary range for this full-time position is $24.5/hr to $28/hr
  • This role may be eligible to discretionary bonus, incentives and benefits 
  • Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location
